why_best: It mirrors the feeling of creation within a modern software workspace, visually transforming chaotic ideas into crisp, operational structure.
why_bad: A simple standard fade or static line-by-line slide would feel banal, completely stripping the sequence of its sense of underlying power and technical energy.
trap: A near-miss will let the arriving embers remain slightly blurred or misaligned at the end, ruining the critical contrast between wild dynamic motion and crisp, legible typography.
